usman_note: Two dogs, two answers. (1) Pugad Lawin, k07 and k11: this dog IS Usman. Episode 49 ends with Usman at Indio's feet 'in the present now, no longer vanishing', episode 50 opens years later with the same three marks (black, white chest, one folded ear) beside Indio's child, and the fact check of this very script lists 'kami ni Usman' among the invented things in the episode, so Usman is on screen. The series cast says he always wears the red kerchief; the prompts left it out. The missing kerchief is therefore an off_model fault on k07 (already inside reader 1's must-fix entry) and on k11 (added). (2) The first meadow, k24, k25, k27, k28: not a fault. The narrator calls it only 'a black dog' in another world at the very beginning, before Indio or anyone could have tied a kerchief on him; the scene works because the three body marks alone tell the viewer who he is, and a kerchief there would contradict 'the very beginning'. Those keys are judged only on the body marks (one folded ear, short coat, chest patch), which is where k24, k25 and k28 fail.
